en.inputs: ① Shredded tobacco leaf (Heading 24.01), ② Acetate filter (Chapter 56), ③ Cigarette paper made from tobacco leaf (Heading 24.03), ④ Tipping paper (Chapter 48), ⑤ Adhesive (Chapter 35), ⑥ Flavoring (Chapter 33)
en.process: The subject product is manufactured in Indonesia by using the above raw materials and carrying out rolling, etc.
en.reasoning: All of the above raw materials are treated as non-originating materials. For a product classified under Heading 24.02 of the Customs Tariff Schedule produced in Indonesia using non-originating materials to be recognized as an originating good of Indonesia under the Japan-Indonesia Economic Partnership Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the Agreement"), it must satisfy the product-specific rules concerning the tariff classification number of the product prescribed in Annex 2 of the Agreement and other relevant provisions of the Agreement pursuant to Article 29.1(c) of the Agreement. Since the non-originating materials used in the subject product satisfy the above product-specific rule "CTH", the subject product is recognized as an originating good of Indonesia under the Agreement. However, the application of the tariff rate for originating goods of Indonesia under the Agreement is conditional upon fulfilling all other requirements prescribed in Chapter 3 of the Agreement, Article 61 of the Cabinet Order for Enforcement of the Customs Tariff Act, and other relevant laws and regulations.
